EN:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Whaah?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} What's up with you?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Don't
get nervous! This town isn't going
anywhere, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Ouais ?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Qu'est-ce t'as à courir dans
tous les sens ?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} La ville va pas
s'faire la malle,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Vay be?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Sana ne oldu?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Bu kadar gerilme!
Kasaba bir yere kaçmıyor, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
Hey, relax!{{TAG:0003:002C:}} It's not like you have to
hurry up and catch the last train
home or anything.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}There's no rush.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Play all night if you
want, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
¡Eh, para el carro!{{TAG:0003:002C:}} Ni que se fuese a
acabar el mundo... ¡Menudas prisas!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}No, no, no...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mira, ¡vamos a estar
de buen rollito esta noche mientras
el cuerpo aguante, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
Ho, calmos ! {{TAG:0003:001B:}}On dirait qu't'as un
train à prendre...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}T'as tout l'temps qu'tu veux.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Reste
t'amuser toute la nuit si ça t'chante,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
Ehi, non ti agitare!{{TAG:0003:002C:}} Non è che devi
sbrigarti per prendere l'ultimo
treno che ti riporti a casa.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Qui ci sono treni tutta la notte.
Non c'è fretta.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Resta pure
quanto vuoi, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
Hey, nur die Ruhe!{{TAG:0003:002C:}} Ist ja nicht so,
als müssteste gleich den letzten
Zug nach Hause erwischen.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Also immer locker bleiben!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Amüsier
dich, so viel du willst, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}All right, look, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} If you
got somethin' to say, just go ahead
and say it, will ya? {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bon, écoute, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Si t'as un
truc à dire, c'est maintenant ou
jamais, OK ? {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Allora, {{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} se c'è qualcosa
che devi dirmi, fallo senza girarci
intorno, OK? {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bak şimdi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Söyleyecek

mı? {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
